title: Cinematic Summer Rooftop Portrait
full_prompt: Use the uploaded portrait only as the identity reference. Preserve the person’s real facial features, face shape, skin tone, and recognizable hairstyle. Do not copy the original outfit, background, pose, lighting, or image quality from the uploaded portrait. Setting: An old green-tiled rooftop under dense tree shadows. Subject Action: Sitting quietly, relaxed, looking slightly downward with a soft, calm expression. Environmental Details: Dark green foliage, hanging red pomegranate fruits, scattered sunlight, and natural leaf-shaped shadows cast across the subject and roof. Storytelling Element: A vintage handheld camera placed casually nearby. Vibe: Natural, clean, elegant, lightweight, and suitable for a dreamy outdoor summer portrait. Framing: Low-angle composition; full-body or three-quarter body framing. Lighting/Atmosphere: Cinematic natural light, strong contrast (deep shadows vs. bright sun patches), subtle lens flare, and a poetic summer mood. Quality Markers: Soft film grain, realistic skin texture, natural body proportions, shallow depth of field, and high-detail editorial quality. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
creator: @Shinning1010

title: Ultra-Premium Automotive Social Posters
full_prompt: 4:5 vertical social poster, ultra high resolution, 8K. SCENE / BACKGROUND: Flat racing yellow with subtle gradient (light → deep amber) 2–3% grain texture, and 3% opacity rectangular overlays. PRODUCT: Gloss yellow Porsche 911 GT3 RS with carbon details; positioned right of center with a dominant wing. TYPOGRAPHY: Primary: 'PORSCHE' (Ultra tall, condensed, stretched, deep charcoal). Secondary: 'PORSCHE 911 GT3 RS'. Faded Text: 'GT3 RS' at 3–5% opacity. EDITORIAL CONTENT: Headline: 'Porsche — Where Precision Meets Passion'. Focus: Engineering, obsession, track DNA. Technical Specs: 386 kW / 525 PS, 3.2 s, 296 km/h. Lighting: Clean studio lighting with sharp, controlled highlights. Camera: 50mm lens, slightly elevated rear 3/4 perspective.
creator: @Diplomeme

title: Luxury Sportswear Campaign: DESIRE THE WORK
full_prompt: Hyper-realistic global sportswear campaign poster titled: 'DESIRE THE WORK.' This should NOT look like a sportswear catalog. This should feel like the most expensive Nike campaign never made. Vertical premium poster divided into four dynamic zones: Top Left: Elite female sprinter exploding from blocks (low angle, muscle tension, sweat droplets). Top Right: Male basketball player at the apex of a dunk (rain falling, halo lighting, athletic physique). Bottom Left: Female boxer wrapping hands (close-up, direct eye contact, dangerous feel). Bottom Right: Male footballer striking a ball (wet jersey, exploding turf, visible veins). Centerpiece: An abstract, fractured swoosh-inspired shape created from motion trails, rain, sweat, chalk dust, and turf debris. Typography: Massive condensed bold lettering 'DESIRE THE WORK' stretching across the poster. Micro-Typography: '04:37 AM', 'NO SHORTCUTS.', 'REPEAT.', 'AGAIN.', 'PRESSURE IS A PRIVILEGE.' Lighting: Premium sports-fashion style; deep blacks, hard highlights, rim lighting, and high commercial contrast. Color Palette: Deep black, bright white, metallic silver, storm gray, with subtle electric neon accents.
creator: @hemayxn

title: Apple-Style Smartphone Ad: PRO, WITHOUT TRYING
full_prompt: 4:5 vertical premium smartphone campaign poster, ultra-high resolution (8K), global OOH + digital + social ready. Style: Apple-level minimalism combined with bold Gen-Z composition. Intent: 'PRO, WITHOUT TRYING.' Vibe: Effortless power, quiet confidence, and precision. Background: Pure matte white canvas featuring a dominant rounded rectangle block with an ultra-vibrant burnt orange gradient. Background Typography: The word 'PRO' in ultra-bold geometric sans-serif, stretched wide kerning, partially cropped by edges with a subtle emboss effect. Subject: Female model with a clean editorial look and neutral, confident expression; wearing muted tones (off-white and deep maroon jacket); low-angle hero perspective, one hand extending the phone toward the camera. Hero Product: iPhone 17 Pro in 'Titanium Orange' with hyper-sharp triple camera system and brushed titanium edges. Lighting: Soft studio key light (front-left) and warm edge light (right). Color Palette: Apple Orange, Clean White, Warm highlights. Typography: Small black Apple logo, 'Built for Apple Intelligence', 'iPhone 17 Pro' in glass-morphism UI pill, and feature cards for A19 PRO CHIP, 48MP PRO CAMERA, 4K DOLBY VISION, APPLE INTELLIGENCE.
creator: @Diplomeme
